q02.answer:
The Siti Hasmah Digital Library (which includes the Law Library) has different operating hours depending on the period:

*   **Trimester:**
    *   Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM
    *   Saturday – Sunday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
*   **Trimester Break:**
    *   Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
    *   Weekend: Closed
*   **Examination Week:**
    *   Daily: 9:00 AM – 12:00 AM
*   **Public Holidays:**
    *   Closed

q03.answer: You are allowed to repeat a course up to a maximum of two (2) times. If you fail a course more than two times and your status is dismissed, your appeal for reinstatement may not be considered. (Source: 2025 Academic Handbook.pdf, page 23, 66)

q04.answer: You can withdraw from a subject up to week seven (7) in a long trimester.

q05.answer:
The minimum passing mark for a subject is 40% (grade D) for all programmes in Foundation, Diploma, and Bachelor (UGRD & UGDE).

However, this excludes programmes governed by professional bodies, which are:
*   Bachelor of Law (FOL)
*   Bachelor of Accounting (FOB and FOM)
*   Diploma in Accounting (FOB)

(Source: 2025 Academic Handbook.pdf, page 49)

q06.answer: The convocation ceremony to celebrate graduates is normally held in November/December every year.

q07.answer:
No, you cannot graduate if your CGPA is 1.90, even if you pass all your courses.

According to the 2025 Academic Handbook, students will not graduate if they pass all courses but obtain a CGPA of less than 2.00. The graduation requirement is a CGPA and GPA of 2.00. You would be required to repeat course(s) to increase your CGPA to at least 2.00.

q08.answer: For a non-engineering student in a 14-lecture-week trimester, the maximum number of credit hours they may register is 20 CH. This applies to students who are not following their programme structure (NFPS).

q09.answer: To achieve First Class Honours for a Bachelor's Degree Programme, you need a CGPA between 3.67 and 4.00. (Source: 2025 Academic Handbook.pdf, page 71)

q10.answer: The graduation fee for a PhD degree is RM 450.00.

q11.answer:
To be on the Dean's List, students must fulfill the following requirements:

*   **Foundation:**
    *   Minimum GPA: 3.67
    *   Minimum Total Credit Hours for graded subjects: 12 (Long Trimester) or 6 (Short Trimester)
*   **Bachelor/Diploma:**
    *   Minimum GPA: 3.50
    *   Minimum Total Credit Hours for graded subjects: 12 (Long Trimester) or 6 (Short Trimester)

(Source: 2025 Academic Handbook.pdf, page 54)

q12.answer: No, students are only entitled to one MMU scholarship at any one time. Combining scholarships or financial aids from MMU is not allowed [Source: 2026 Scholarship.pdf, page 7].

q13.answer: To maintain the MMU President's Scholarship, recipients must maintain a CGPA of 3.50 throughout their duration of study. (Source: 2026 Scholarship.pdf, page 1)

q14.answer:
For enquiries regarding YUM Financial Assistance, you can contact them via:
*   **Phone:** 03-8312 5040/5043/5103
*   **Email:** yum@mmu.edu.my

q15.answer: MMU staff with 10 years or more of service are eligible for a 50% discount on programme fees for their children's studies.

q16.answer: The Examinations & Records Unit is open on Friday from 8:30 AM – 12:45 PM and 2:30 PM – 5:45 PM.

q17.answer: Labour Day in 2026 is on **1 May (Friday)**.

q20.answer:
Alvin Lim teaches the following courses:

*   Data Structure and Algorithms

q21.answer: The President of Multimedia University (MMU) is Prof. Dato’ Dr. Mazliham Mohd Su’ud (Source: 2025 MMU PostGraduate June.pdf, page 2).

q22.answer: The registration fee for local postgraduate students is RM 570.

q23.answer:
The Finance Office is located in the Administration Building, on Level 1.

To get there:
*   Enter the Administration Building main door.
*   Take the stairs or lift to Level 1.
*   Turn right; the Finance Office is the second door.

It is located beside the Student Services Centre.

q24.answer:
You can pay your fees via:
*   **MMU E-Payment**: https://bit.ly/3i7hRml
*   **Flywire (for payments from overseas)**: https://mmulanding.flywire.com

(Source: 2926 March Student Guide.pdf, page 15)

q25.answer:
The Student Services Centre (SSC) is located on the Ground Level of the Administration Building.

You can find it immediately to the left of the main entrance. It is also below the Finance Office and near the covered walkway.
